gate_purpose: Design the internal England/Flanders local expert and source refresh gate without executing source refresh or substituting local experts.

allowed_review_scope: Check official-source interpretation for Book 1 Chapters 1.2 and 1.3 gate planning.
Identify source gaps, terminology uncertainty, pathway/assessment boundaries, and local review questions.

forbidden_authority: No legal advice or compliance proof.

No school implementation evidence or support/accommodation sufficiency claim.
No localized student, teacher, school, public, product-route, or Scale Gate output.
local_expert_role_contracts.source_review_responsibility: Review only the explicit official source allowlist and identify stale, replaced, unavailable, gap, or outside-scope states.
local_expert_role_contracts.curriculum_assessment_review_responsibil: Check DfE subject-content and selected AQA representative boundaries without broadening to all awarding bodies or the whole UK.
local_expert_role_contracts.language_terminology_review_responsibili: Identify terminology that would need local review before any localized output; do not author localized paragraphs or exercises.
local_expert_role_contracts.accessibility_inclusion_review_responsib: Identify accessibility/inclusion terminology and support-boundary questions; do not decide accommodations or support sufficiency.
local_expert_role_contracts.legal_claim_boundary: Expert review may inform internal source/curriculum interpretation but may not substitute for legal advice, compliance proof, approval, accreditation, OP0, PTA, summative validity, or inspection-readiness claims.
local_expert_role_contracts.school_owned_evidence_boundary: School-owned evidence, learner records, accommodations, support plans, implementation quality, and local assessment evidence remain outside this gate.
local_expert_role_contracts.conflict_uncertainty_handling: Record uncertainty as a blocker with affected source IDs, affected rows, owner next action, and proof required to close.
local_expert_role_contracts.required_output_format: Structured internal review record with source IDs, condition classification, affected rows, allowed inference, forbidden inference, blocks, does_not_block, and proof_required_to_close.
